title: Filipino Chicken Biryani
description: A flavorful and aromatic rice dish from the Philippines, made with chicken and spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat. Add the onion, garlic, and ginger and sauté until the onion is translucent.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the tomato paste, fish sauce, sugar, salt, and pepper. Stir well to combine.
Add the biryani rice and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the rice mixture to a large pot and add enough water to cover the rice. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 18-20 minutes, or until the water has been absorbed.
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve hot.
